articles.summary: FALLS CHURCH, Va., May 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The board of directors of Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE: NOC) declared a quarterly dividend of $2.47 per share on Northrop Grumman common stock, payable June 17, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business June 1, 2026.
articles.title: Northrop Grumman Board Declares Quarterly Dividend

articles.summary: Over 30 domestic and global partners recognized for their excellence in manufacturing and supply chain operations FALLS CHURCH, Va., May 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE:NOC) continues to build on its spirit of innovation, honoring suppliers who are critical partners
articles.title: Northrop Grumman Honors Top Suppliers Driving Industrial Innovation

articles.summary: FALLS CHURCH, Va., May 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE: NOC) will participate in Bernstein’s 42 nd Annual Strategic Decisions Conference on Thursday, May 28. Kathy Warden, chair, chief executive officer and president, will present beginning at 10:00 a.m.
articles.title: Northrop Grumman to Participate in Bernstein’s 42nd Annual Strategic Decisions Conference
